results.name: Iso Lateral Shoulder Press Single Arm
instructions: Sit on the Iso-Lateral Shoulder Press machine, back pressed against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing forward.
Press the right handle upward by extending your arm fully while keeping the other arm stationary.
Squeeze your shoulder muscles at the top of the movement and slowly return the handle to the starting position with control.
Repeat with the same arm for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles throughout the movement.
Exhale as you press the handle upward and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
results.description: Iso Lateral Shoulder Press Single Arm is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Jump Rope Face Pull
instructions: Loop the jump rope over a vertical bar or similar stable structure, ensuring the rope is at about hip height. Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handles of the jump rope with both hands.
Step back slightly to create tension in the rope, keeping your core engaged and your back straight.
Pull the rope towards your face by bending your elbows and bringing your hands towards your ears, engaging your upper back and shoulder muscles.
Extend your arms back out to the starting position with control. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together as you pull the rope towards your face to maximize muscle engagement.
Move slowly with control and avoid using momentum to prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the rope towards your face and inhaling as you extend your arms back out.
Ensure the vertical bar or structure is stable and can support the tension in the rope to prevent slipping or injury.
results.description: Jump Rope Face Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a rope, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Biceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell by the handle with both hands in front of you, keeping your arms extended.
Raise the kettlebell forward and upward, keeping your elbows straight as you are lifting the weight.
Continue lifting until your hands reach about chin height and your elbows are near shoulder height.
Lower the kettlebell along the same path until your arms are extended, then repeat.
tips: Maintain an upright torso throughout the exercise.
Avoid leaning backward to lift the kettlebell higher.
Raise and lower the weight smoothly without using momentum.
Exhale as you raise the kettlebell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Kettlebell Front Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Shoulder Press
instructions: Begin in a half-kneeling position with your right knee on the floor and your left foot flat on the floor in front of you. Hold a kettlebell in your right hand, racked at shoulder height with your elbow bent, facing the floor, and close to your body.
Press the kettlebell overhead by extending your right arm fully, keeping your wrist straight and in line with your shoulder.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knee and hip are aligned, maintaining a 90-degree angle in both legs.
Press the kettlebell straight up, avoiding any forward or backward motion.
Exhale as you press the kettlebell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Incline Shrug
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest supported. Hold a kettlebell with both hands using an overhand grip, and let your arms hang straight toward the floor.
Keep your arms straight and shrug your shoulders upward toward your ears, allowing the kettlebell to rise slightly.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your upper back.
Lower your shoulders with control to the starting position, then repeat.
tips: Keep your chest supported on the bench throughout the movement.
Keep your arms straight and avoid bending your elbows.
Keep your neck neutral and your head aligned with your spine.
Exhale as you shrug upward and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Incline Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Kneeling One Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Begin in a kneeling position on both knees with your torso upright. Hold a kettlebell in your right hand at shoulder height, with your elbow bent, facing the floor, and close to your body.
Press the kettlebell overhead by extending your right arm fully, keeping your wrist straight and aligned with your shoulder.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
Press the kettlebell straight up, avoiding any forward or backward motion.
Exhale as you press the kettlebell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Kettlebell Kneeling One Arm Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Long Lever Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell in a neutral grip by your side with your arm straight.
Raise the kettlebell out to the side, keeping your arm extended.
Continue lifting diagonally upward until your elbow is above shoulder height.
Lower the kettlebell along the same path with control, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning to the opposite side.
Avoid swinging the kettlebell or using momentum.
Lower the kettlebell slowly through the full range of motion.
Exhale as you raise the kettlebell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Kettlebell Long Lever Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Rotator Cuff, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, bend your knees slightly, and hinge forward with a straight back. Hold a kettlebell with both hands, in an overhand grip, and let it hang between your legs.
Pull the kettlebell upward toward your upper chest while driving your elbows out to the sides.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze the back of your shoulders and upper back.
Lower the kettlebell with control until your arms are extended, then repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows flared outward rather than tucked against your sides.
Keep your chest up and maintain a stable torso during each repetition.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid excessive shrugging.
Exhale as you pull and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Middle Back, Biceps, Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
instructions: Begin in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height. Your elbows should be bent, facing the floor and your palms facing inward.
Press the kettlebell in your right hand overhead by extending your right arm fully while slightly leaning your torso to your left side.
Lower the right kettlebell back to shoulder height and then press the kettlebell in your left hand overhead by extending your left arm fully and slightly leaning your torso to the right side.
Continue alternating the presses for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Press each kettlebell straight up, avoiding any forward or backward motion.
Exhale as you press each kettlebell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
Ensure your wrists stay straight and aligned with your forearms to prevent strain.
results.description: Kettlebell Seesaw Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, bend your knees slightly, and hinge forward until your torso is parallel to the floor, with your back straight.
Brace your left hand on your left thigh and hold a kettlebell in the right hand using an overhand grip. Let your right arm hang below your shoulder with a slight bend in your elbow.
Keeping your torso still, raise the kettlebell straight behind you until your arm extends past your hip.
Lower the kettlebell with control until your arm returns toward the floor, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep only a slight bend in your working elbow.
Move your arm from the shoulder instead of turning the movement into a row.
Raise the kettlebell straight backward rather than out to the side.
Exhale as you raise the kettlebell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Kettlebell Shoulder Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Forearms, Core.
